llm.summary: This is a narrow mortgage compliance guidance skill with no executable code, persistence, credential use, or hidden behavior.

dimensions.detail: The artifact is coherent with its stated purpose: it gives loan-originator compensation and RESPA guardrails, activation boundaries, examples, red flags, and compliance checklist items.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to advisory review of mortgage incentive and referral arrangements, and the skill explicitly says it is not legal advice and calls for counsel/compliance sign-off.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains a single non-executable SKILL.md file; metadata and the scanner report show no scripts, installers, or additional runtime components.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No local file access, credential access, command execution, package installation, or network workflow is requested. The only URL content appears to be promotional links in prose.

dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

llm.guidance: Install only if you want mortgage LO compensation and RESPA compliance prompts. Treat its legal/compliance content as a checklist aid, not legal advice, and involve qualified counsel or compliance staff before acting on compensation, MSA, referral, or lead-buy arrangements.
llm.findings:
